original.statement: A new optional CLI flag --remote-contexts was added to the istioctl analyze command to specify remote cluster contexts during multi-cluster analysis.

decision.reason: [ev-a2198475a8e4] only says a new optional `remote-contexts` flag was added to `istioctl analyze`. It names no environment state in which anything fails or changes. The proposed exposure, cli-flag `--remote-contexts` unset, would flag nearly every environment, because no existing setup uses a flag that is new. It also treats a flag of the istioctl client command as if it were a container argument of the product's workloads. No exposure condition follows from the evidence, so this assertion should be rejected rather than corrected.
